text: dsh-adb-ultimate 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的 Android ADB 设备管理插件。它注册设备管理工具，并在会话中接入设备面板，可查看已连接设备、通过 Wi-Fi 连接或配对设备、截图和监控屏幕、管理应用与文件，并读取设备信息、性能、电池和日志。工具还支持 UI 层级查看、按界面元素操作、输入与滑动等控制，适合需要在 DSH 会话中查看和操作 Android 设备的用户。运行需要本机可用的 ADB；配对二维码图像通过 api.qrserver.com 提供。

dsh-adb-ultimate manages Android devices over ADB from DSH Web. Its tools and session panel support discovery, Wi-Fi pairing, screen control, app management, and status and log checks. Requires local ADB; QR images use api.qrserver.com.
想让 DSH 帮我通过 ADB 管理 Android 手机。
有没有办法从 DSH 会话里查看和操作已连接的安卓设备？
我想用 Wi-Fi 把 Android 设备连到 DSH。
能不能让 AI 查看手机屏幕并点按界面元素？
I want to connect to and manage an Android device from my DSH session.
Can DSH inspect a phone screen and interact with UI elements through ADB?
dsh-adb-ultimate 的功能「设备连接与发现」：列出 ADB 连接设备，也可通过 IP 和端口发起 Wi-Fi 连接或断开连接。
dsh-adb-ultimate 的功能「屏幕查看与控制」：截取设备屏幕，并支持基于坐标或界面元素进行点按、长按和滑动操作。
dsh-adb-ultimate 的功能「应用与文件管理」：通过工具安装、卸载和启动应用，并提供文件推送与拉取等设备管理操作。
dsh-adb-ultimate 的功能「设备状态与日志」：查询设备内存、电池、系统属性和 logcat 输出，辅助了解设备运行状态。
dsh-adb-ultimate 的功能「Web 设备面板」：在 DSH 会话中查看并管理已连接的 Android 设备。
dsh-adb-ultimate 使用前须知：在 Web 面板生成配对二维码时，二维码内容作为 URL 参数发给 api.qrserver.com 生成图像链接。
想在 DSH 里查手机的电量、内存和系统日志。
我需要从会话里安装应用、截图或读设备信息。

dsh-adb-ultimate 提供工具 adb_wait_for：Wait for element to appear on screen
dsh-adb-ultimate 提供工具 adb_scroll_to：Scroll to find element (swipe down until element appears)
dsh-adb-ultimate 提供工具 adb_screen_capture：Capture current screen as base64 PNG (for streaming)
dsh-adb-ultimate 提供工具 adb_screen_stream_start：Start screen streaming session
dsh-adb-ultimate 提供工具 adb_tap_at：Tap at screen coordinates (with coordinate transformation for streaming)
dsh-adb-ultimate 提供工具 adb_swipe_at：Swipe on screen

Full-featured ADB device management plugin for [DeepSeek Harness (DSH)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness).

dsh-adb-ultimate README · 🚀 Project Motivation：I have a Linux environment called **DROID** running on my Android tablet, with **DSH** deployed in it.

> As a tech enthusiast, I wanted to **control my device with AI** to achieve "self-control" — letting AI:
> - See the device's real-time screen
> - Execute any system operations
> - Automatically manage apps and files on the device
> - Monitor system performance and status
> - ...

dsh-adb-ultimate README · 🚀 Project Motivation：With this idea, **dsh-adb-ultimate** was born. It enables DSH to fully control Android devices through the ADB protocol, truly realizing "AI as your phone assistant".

dsh-adb-ultimate README · 📱 Device Panel：Embeds a complete device management panel in the DSH session with 5 tabs:

| Tab | Features |
|-----|----------|
| 🖥️ **Screen** | Real-time device screen monitoring with play/pause (1s interval) |
| 📊 **Performance** | Real-time memory, CPU, battery status (auto-refresh) |
| 📋 **Info** | Device model, Android version, serial number, etc. |
| 📦 **Apps** | Browse, search, view app details (version, permissions) |
| 📝 **Logs** | Real-time logcat output with V/D/I/W/E level filtering |

dsh-adb-ultimate README · 🔌 Device Connection：- **WiFi Connect** - Connect to Android device via IP address
- **WiFi Pair** - Support pairing verification for first-time connections
- **Connection History** - Auto-save history for quick reconnect
- **Multi-device** - Manage multiple devices simultaneously

dsh-adb-ultimate README · 🎮 Device Control：- **Screen** - Screenshot, screen on/off, real-time monitoring
- **Input** - Tap, swipe, text input, key events
- **Apps** - Install, uninstall, launch, force stop
- **File** - Push/pull files

dsh-adb-ultimate README · 📊 Performance Monitoring：- **Memory** - Real-time RAM usage
- **Battery** - Level, temperature, health status
- **CPU** - Cores, processor model

dsh-adb-ultimate README · 🔧 System Debug：- **Logcat** - Real-time log output with level filtering
- **Dumpsys** - Query system service info
- **Getprop** - Read system properties
- **Shell** - Execute shell commands directly
dsh-adb-ultimate README · Install：> 💡 Copy any install command below and give it to Agent for automatic installation

dsh plugin --profile web add github:newborne/dsh-adb-ultimate

dsh-adb-ultimate README · Install to DSH：dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-adb-ultimate
```

dsh-adb-ultimate README · Way 3: Natural Language Install：Just tell Agent:
> "Help me install this plugin: https://github.com/newborne/dsh-adb-ultimate"
